text:
Implement Contrastable[S, D], with SignedDifference for Double/Similarity/MeasureDistance and five named signed components for MultiMatchScore. Bounded scores do not form a group under subtraction. Contrast retains both Analysis operands and their original PairwiseAnalysis evidence, aligns the focal-key union by equality, and orders output with a caller-supplied lawful Ordering. Observed ordering collisions fail explicitly. Per-key entries retain selected/successful/failed/contributing counts; failed reductions contribute zero.

EvaluationInfo now optionally carries a smart-constructed EvaluationSpec: stable method/revision, canonical named typed parameters, ordered score components, spatial metadata with UnitLabel witness, and temporal convention. Legacy scoring/reduction remains supported; contrast rejects missing declarations. Authors must declare all score-affecting preprocessing and method parameters; arbitrary evaluator functions cannot be inferred. Compatibility checks scales, orientations, failure policies, method specs, components, geometry and temporal conventions. Retained geometry metadata delegates to new overloads at the existing Agreement seam, with typed frame/grid/clock failures. Different input digests are retained rather than rejected. Declarations also enter structured provenance so parameter changes affect cache identity.

No general plugin registry, persistence framework, new CSV parser, or R export schema is introduced here. Existing typed fixation admission and the public example run the concrete study through production contrast; general fixation-table admission and comparison exports remain baseline usability work. Next core slice is the concrete plan/registry/codec boundary in docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. See docs/CONTRAST_CONTRACT.md and published ContrastLaws for the executable contract.
